what: A stack of cards overlaps in one spot (each card further back is 10px lower · .04 smaller · −3°/+3°, hidden from the fourth). Pressing the front card sends it flying right by card width + 40px in .16s ease-out, fading, and it goes to the back. Dragging with the mouse makes it follow by the dragged amount and tilt horizontally ×.04 (±10°), and on release it is thrown in the dragged direction by diagonal length + 40px (a finger moves only horizontally, 25% (max 100px) .38s). The stack tilts up to 2° as the panel passes the screen center (per card 1·−.75·.5×). Arrow keys also advance it.

options.spacing: Px the back card settles down, default 10
options.scroll: Max scroll tilt (degrees), default 2 — 0 turns it off

from.where: index.html .rv__stack — five review cards (original site code block review_stack)

note: Pressing a link/button inside a card does not throw it. Touch drags only horizontally, so a vertical swipe scrolls the page
